name: balanced
description: Default Anderson model mix. Opus for the arbiter, Sonnet for cross-document reasoning agents (reviewers, hard checkers, strategist, fixer, literature_searcher), Haiku for the mechanical agents (extraction, graph building, mechanical checkers, highlighter, report writer). Override globally for one session with the CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL env var. Override per-agent by editing the static `model:` field in .claude/agents/<name>.md (this JSON is documentation only — agent frontmatter is the source of truth). Models use Claude Code's short aliases (sonnet/opus/haiku/inherit), not full IDs.
